invariants: Nothing leaves an installation for an integration that is not enabled. Handlers for disabled integrations answer 403 integration_disabled.
With EVER_CONNECT_ENABLED unset or false, the Ever Connect module is not loaded and the installation makes no calls to any Ever Platform host.
Only the fields listed under scope may move, and only in the listed form and at the listed frequency.
An installation operator can deny any integration for every tenant with EVER_CONNECT_INTEGRATIONS_DENY=<key,...>. The state becomes denied_by_policy, which tenant administrators cannot override.

Consent is granted by an organization owner or admin, in app.ever.co or in the product's own consent dialog after a fresh Ever ID sign-in; both record the same consent. Discoverability and the installation address are enabled in app.ever.co only. Each consent is recorded, can be revoked at any time, and every change is logged.

Integrations that act for the whole installation (instance_url, stats_link, ever_id_login, webhooks) can be enabled only by the organization that owns the installation's connection, and they start only after the installation's operator also accepts them on the installation, on multi-tenant servers too.
No per-record business data (invoices, amounts, customer lists, documents) is sent to Ever Platform by any integration in this catalog.
Anonymous usage statistics (ever.stats.v1) are not an integration. They follow their own published allow-list and are switched off with EVER_STATS_ENABLED=false.

integrations.name: Managed updates and backups
integrations.description: Lets an owner or admin ask this self-hosted installation, from app.ever.co, to run a maintenance operation: an update, a backup, a restore check or a health report. Requests reach the installation through its own outbound connection; the operator also turns the feature on locally and sets when and what may run. Backups stay in your own storage, and Ever Platform sees only each operation's status and size. Ever never connects in.
integrations.revoke_effect: Queued operations are cancelled and nothing further runs.
integrations.notes: Ever already operates its cloud installations, so this is offered on self-hosted installations only. It becomes active per product once that product can run the operations. Ever Teams is covered by its Ever Gauzy server.
